n016cbacc4d.headline: Gov. Kemp Signs Tax Rebate, Gas Tax Moratorium Bills
n016cbacc4d.summary: Governor Brian Kemp signed HB 1000 and HB 1199, authorising about $1.2 billion in state income tax refunds and suspending the state motor fuel tax for 60 days.
n016cbacc4d.why: State tax rebates and fuel tax changes affect household spending and state fiscal balances in Georgia.

n55459877f3.headline: Stamp Shock: USPS Wants to Charge You Almost $1 Per Letter
n55459877f3.summary: The US Postal Service is considering raising the price of a first-class stamp to nearly $1 per letter, according to a report.
n55459877f3.why: Postal pricing affects mail-dependent businesses and the financial cost of physical correspondence in the US.

n27b471bcb3.headline: Trump says the U.S. is in talks with Iran to end the war, which Iran denies
n27b471bcb3.summary: Trump said the U.S. will postpone strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure for five days and claimed talks are under way to end the war, which Iran denies. Israel continued strikes on Tehran.
n27b471bcb3.why: Iran is a major oil producer and any threat to its energy infrastructure or Gulf shipping can move global crude prices.
n27b471bcb3.why_moved: Trump's announced five-day pause on strikes against Iranian energy infrastructure reduces the immediate threat to oil supply, although Iran denied talks and warned of retaliation across the Gulf.

nb9231f87af.headline: Signs of dialogue trigger pivot to the buy side
nb9231f87af.summary: The MIB index moved into positive territory mid-day in the week's first session, climbing above 43,700 points. The main driver cited was a sharp retracement in oil prices.
nb9231f87af.why: The FTSE MIB is the benchmark index of the Italian stock market, tracking the country's largest listed companies across banking, energy and industry.
nb9231f87af.why_moved: The report attributes the index's shift to positive territory mainly to a sharp retreat in oil prices, which eases inflation and energy cost concerns.

nf8ee9b9159.headline: China Limits Fuel Price Hike to Cushion Impact of Rising Oil Prices
nf8ee9b9159.summary: China raised regulated retail gasoline and diesel price ceilings on Monday but capped the increase at about half the usual level. The adjustments were still the largest on record.
nf8ee9b9159.why: Retail fuel price caps in China affect domestic inflation, refiners' margins and demand for crude imports, making them important for energy investors.

n09a6a5d7fd.headline: Renewables on rise: How EBRD financing drives Azerbaijan’s low-carbon transition
n09a6a5d7fd.summary: The EBRD has invested €3.629 billion in Azerbaijan, with €3.375 billion allocated to development initiatives. The bank has financed over 1.2 gigawatts of renewable energy capacity.
n09a6a5d7fd.why: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development is a multilateral lender that co-finances infrastructure and clean energy projects in emerging markets.

n6a5c39a466.headline: Live updates: Trump says Iran wants a deal to end the war as Tehran denies negotiating
n6a5c39a466.summary: Trump extended his deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and said the US would hold off on power plant strikes for five days. Tehran denies it is negotiating.
n6a5c39a466.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key route for global oil shipments, so uncertainty over its status directly affects crude oil prices and shipping costs.
n6a5c39a466.why_moved: The deadline extension and Tehran's denial leave the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz uncertain. Oil prices tend to react to such uncertainty over Gulf shipping routes.

n4950f3defd.headline: Ukraine will fail to meet 25 partner program requirements worth EUR 7 bln by end of Q1 2026 – MP
n4950f3defd.summary: Ukraine's parliament will not have time to fulfil 25 structural measures by end-Q1 2026 required under IMF, World Bank and Ukraine Facility programmes, according to MP Yaroslav Zhelezniak.
n4950f3defd.why: IMF and EU support programmes disburse funds only when reform conditions are met, so missed conditions can delay financing for Ukraine's budget.

n0e42e3c266.headline: Poste’s TIM Bid Is Really a Bet on Rebuilding Italy Inc
n0e42e3c266.summary: Rome is trying to turn an old telecom problem into a strategic asset, with Poste's bid for TIM presented as part of a broader plan to rebuild Italian industry.
n0e42e3c266.why: Poste Italiane is the state-controlled postal and financial group, and TIM is Italy's former national telecom incumbent, so the bid involves major national assets.

n5db0528968.headline: Iran threatens to retaliate against Gulf energy and water after Trump ultimatum
n5db0528968.summary: Iran warned it would strike energy and water infrastructure across the Gulf if the US attacks its electricity grid. Trump set a Monday deadline for the threat.
n5db0528968.why: The Gulf is a major oil and gas exporting region that relies heavily on desalination. Attacks on its infrastructure would hit crude supply and regional stability.
n5db0528968.why_moved: Threats against Gulf energy and water infrastructure raise fears of supply disruption in a region central to global oil and desalination. Investors price in higher geopolitical risk.

nba631c7f7a.headline: STI closes 2.2% down as Asia markets drop on Trump, Iran threats; gold wipes out gains this year
nba631c7f7a.summary: The Straits Times Index closed 2.2% lower as Asian markets fell on Trump's and Iran's threats. Trump said the US would 'obliterate' Iran's power plants unless the Strait of Hormuz fully reopens.
nba631c7f7a.why: The Straits Times Index tracks Singapore's largest listed companies and is a key regional benchmark. Its moves reflect broader Asian risk sentiment.
nba631c7f7a.why_moved: Asian markets fell on US threats to strike Iran's power plants and on Iran's pressure over the Strait of Hormuz. Investors reacted to the escalating geopolitical risk.

nda4f121740.headline: IEA Head Says Global Economy Faces ‘Major, Major Threat’ from Iran War
nda4f121740.summary: IEA head Fatih Birol said the global economy faces a major threat from the Iran war, with the crisis hitting oil harder than two previous oil shocks. He spoke in Canberra.
nda4f121740.why: The International Energy Agency advises major oil-consuming countries on energy security and publishes closely watched oil market forecasts. Its warnings signal risks to energy prices and growth.

nc1a42df4cf.headline: Sunset Market Commentary
nc1a42df4cf.summary: Brent crude traded above $114 a barrel as markets resumed the Iran risk-off trade. The move came ahead of a US ultimatum for Iran to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
nc1a42df4cf.why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil.
nc1a42df4cf.why_moved: Trump's ultimatum for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz kept supply risk high, and markets resumed a risk-off trade on stagflation concerns.

n3b1f40d550.headline: US will hold off on Iran power plant strikes for 5 days, extending Trump deadline on Hormuz strait
n3b1f40d550.summary: Trump extended his deadline for Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and said the US will hold off on power plant strikes for five days. The strait is a key route for global oil shipments.
n3b1f40d550.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so disruptions there move crude prices and energy-importing economies.
n3b1f40d550.why_moved: The extended deadline keeps uncertainty over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, a key oil transit route, and the threat of power plant strikes remains.

nb9a24bd156.headline: Russia Opposes Hormuz Blockade, Interfax Reports
nb9a24bd156.summary: Russia opposes any blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, according to Interfax citing the Russian Foreign Ministry. The ministry warned the US not to threaten the Bushehr nuclear power plant.
nb9a24bd156.why: Russia is a major oil producer and a diplomatic actor in the Iran conflict, so its stance can influence energy-route risk.

n1f0aa7ea40.headline: Thailand Confirms Sufficient Oil Supply, Advancing Regulatory Measures To Enhance Transparency Market » IndiaPost NewsPaper
n1f0aa7ea40.summary: The Thai government said the country holds sufficient oil reserves to meet demand for up to 103 days. The statement came amid reports of fuel shortages and moves to improve market transparency.
n1f0aa7ea40.why: Thailand imports most of its crude and refined fuel, so reserve levels and supply disruptions affect its energy costs and economy.

n64be50c6d3.headline: Chancellor to set out action as surging prices spark profiteering fears
n64be50c6d3.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves will make a statement to MPs on Tuesday on surging prices and profiteering fears. The announcement follows concerns about firms raising prices.
n64be50c6d3.why: Government action on pricing and profiteering can affect consumer-facing companies and the outlook for UK inflation and policy.

ne2763730fb.headline: Strait of Hormuz crisis threatens world fertilizer supply chain
ne2763730fb.summary: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has sent shockwaves through energy and fertilizer markets, with rising costs threatening farmers' production schedules.
ne2763730fb.why: Fertilizer prices feed directly into agricultural costs and food supply, and Gulf shipping routes carry significant energy and fertilizer trade.

na3db888562.headline: Devyani International to invest in Thailand’s KFC operator Restaurants Development
na3db888562.summary: After the transaction closes, Devyani International's subsidiary Devyani International DMCC will own a 49% stake in Thailand's KFC operator Restaurants Development.
na3db888562.why: Devyani International is an Indian operator of quick-service restaurant franchises, and this deal extends its footprint into Southeast Asia.

n0d4927062d.headline: Iran Tensions Push Investors Toward 2022 Playbook as Inflation Risks Rise
n0d4927062d.summary: A three-reading bill was submitted to Iranian lawmakers to formally start Iran's exit from the NPT. The measure was announced by MP Malik Shariati.
n0d4927062d.why: The NPT is the main international framework limiting nuclear weapons proliferation. Withdrawal would raise sanctions and geopolitical risk for Iran and the wider region.

n396b1f4899.headline: Gold vs Silver: Why Both Metals Are Falling Despite Global Uncertainty
n396b1f4899.summary: Gold and silver rates are on a sustained downtrend in March 2026, dragged by a firm dollar and a cautious US Federal Reserve. Both metals are falling despite global uncertainty.
n396b1f4899.why: Gold and silver are traded globally and priced in US dollars, so a stronger dollar makes them more expensive for other buyers. Their prices also respond to interest-rate expectations, since they pay no yield.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: A firm dollar and cautious Fed stance are pressuring gold prices lower.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Silver is falling alongside gold under the same dollar and Fed pressures.

n93220edc20.headline: Rationing not yet on the cards as fuel outlook worsens
n93220edc20.summary: Australia has been assured by a key trading partner that its fuel supplies are not at risk. The fuel outlook has nonetheless worsened.
n93220edc20.why: Australia imports much of its refined fuel, so supply disruptions from Middle East conflicts directly affect domestic prices and logistics. Fuel security is a key economic risk for the country.

n0780aa7070.headline: Laopu Gold sales, profit beat as gold rally fuels demand
n0780aa7070.summary: Laopu Gold's net income rose 230% to 4.87 billion yuan, in line with forecasts. The company said the gold rally fuelled demand for its products.
n0780aa7070.why: Laopu Gold is a Chinese gold jewellery retailer, so its earnings are sensitive to gold prices and consumer demand for jewellery in China.

ne0487b7e97.headline: Trump puts off threat to bomb Iran energy infrastructure
ne0487b7e97.summary: US President Donald Trump has put off a threat to bomb Iran's energy infrastructure. Turkey, Egypt and Pakistan are reportedly mediating.
ne0487b7e97.why: Iran is a major oil producer, so threats to its energy facilities feed directly into crude prices and the risk premium on Gulf supply.
ne0487b7e97.why_moved: The postponement reduces the near-term risk of strikes on Iranian energy facilities, which had raised fears of supply disruption.

nf7ab1f9703.headline: War-Induced Rise in Energy Prices May Reduce India
nf7ab1f9703.summary: Moody's says rising energy prices, a weaker rupee and inflation could dent India's growth. India could be among the worst-hit economies in the region due to energy import dependence.
nf7ab1f9703.why: India imports most of its oil and gas, so higher energy prices widen its trade deficit and feed into inflation and currency pressure.

n9fda04e601.headline: Iraq pulled into Iran war as US targets Iran-aligned groups
n9fda04e601.summary: Iraq is increasingly caught between the US and Iran as the regional war escalates. The conflict is deepening the country's economic problems.
n9fda04e601.why: Iraq is a major oil producer, so regional conflict there can affect crude supply and government revenues.

n670ea3ad00.headline: UAE Equities Decline
n670ea3ad00.summary: Dubai's main share index fell 2.7% in early trade on Monday, dragged down by a 4.6% drop in Emaar Properties and a 2.9% fall in Emirates NBD. Energy price increases, air travel disruption and Strait of Hormuz shipping problems were cited.
n670ea3ad00.why: The Dubai Financial Market index tracks major UAE listings, and Emaar is a leading developer whose shares weigh heavily on it. Gulf markets are sensitive to regional conflict and oil flows.
n670ea3ad00.why_moved: Higher energy prices, disrupted air travel and Strait of Hormuz shipping problems from the regional conflict weighed on UAE stocks, with blue-chip developer and lender shares leading the fall.

n352f748de3.headline: China’s latest Five-Year Plan opens co-creation opportunities for Singapore companies
n352f748de3.summary: China's latest economic blueprint focuses on emerging industries, technological self-reliance and boosting consumption, opening co-creation opportunities for Singapore companies.
n352f748de3.why: Five-Year Plans set China's long-term economic priorities and guide state and private investment. They shape opportunities for foreign companies in targeted sectors.

nfb24257371.headline: Saudi Arabia Slashes Oil Supply to Asia as War Chokes Export Route
nfb24257371.summary: Saudi Arabia is sharply reducing crude exports to Asia as disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz push more barrels onto limited Red Sea routes.
nfb24257371.why: Saudi Aramco is the kingdom's state oil producer and exporter, and Asia is a major destination for Gulf crude. Export routing changes shape global oil supply and prices.
nfb24257371.why_moved: Hormuz disruptions limit Gulf export routes, and crude is being forced onto constrained Red Sea routes, tightening supply to Asian buyers.

n59e7c78115.headline: Iran denies talks with US after Trump postpones strikes
n59e7c78115.summary: Iranian officials denied holding talks with the US, hours after President Donald Trump claimed such talks had taken place and that strikes were being postponed.
n59e7c78115.why: Iran's government controls the Strait of Hormuz, a key chokepoint for global oil flows. Diplomatic signals from Tehran and Washington directly affect energy risk premiums.
n59e7c78115.why_moved: Conflicting statements on talks and strike timing raise uncertainty over Middle East supply disruption, which tends to lift oil prices.

nab9071df59.headline: CBI Acts to Address Dollar Restrictions on Banks | Iraq Business News
nab9071df59.summary: The Central Bank of Iraq has announced a series of measures to address issues affecting Iraqi banks restricted from dealing in US dollars, working with international audit firms.
nab9071df59.why: Dollar access is critical for Iraq's banks, which settle oil-linked and international payments in US currency through correspondent banks.

source.name: Iraq Business News | All the latest business news from Iraq

sources.name: Iraq Business News | All the latest business news from Iraq

n90ada81b65.headline: Singapore stocks fall on Monday; STI down 2.2%
n90ada81b65.summary: Singapore stocks fell on Monday, with the Straits Times Index down 2.2%, and losers outnumbering gainers 554 to 144 across the broader market on heavy volume.
n90ada81b65.why: The Straits Times Index tracks Singapore's largest listed companies and is a key benchmark for Southeast Asian equity markets.
n90ada81b65.why_moved: The report gives no specific cause; the broad selloff, with losers far outnumbering gainers, points to wide-based market weakness.

n74d682fbfd.headline: Rationing not yet on the cards as fuel outlook worsens
n74d682fbfd.summary: Australia has been reassured by a key trading partner that its fuel supplies are not at risk, while other supply concerns mount. Rationing is not yet on the cards.
n74d682fbfd.why: Australia imports most of its refined fuel, so supply disruptions quickly affect its economy and households. Government fuel security decisions shape domestic prices and logistics.

n8a50514fb4.headline: ‘War has no benefit for anyone’: Iraq’s Kurdistan region hit by rising prices, instability amid Iran conflict
n8a50514fb4.summary: Output from Iraq's main southern oilfields has dropped sharply as the Iran conflict has effectively shut down the Strait of Hormuz. Kurdistan residents report rising prices and instability.
n8a50514fb4.why: Iraq is a major crude oil producer that relies on Gulf export routes, so disruptions to Hormuz directly affect its output and government revenue.

n581f345f6a.headline: Stock market today: Gift Nifty down 365 points; key levels for Nifty, Sensex & Nifty Bank - BusinessToday
n581f345f6a.summary: Nifty futures on the NSE International Exchange were down 365.60 points, or 1.58 per cent, at 22,775, pointing to a negative start for the domestic market on Monday.
n581f345f6a.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, and Gift Nifty futures trade in Gujarat and offer an early read on the Indian market.
n581f345f6a.why_moved: Gift Nifty futures traded lower in the pre-market session, indicating a negative opening for the Indian benchmark index.

n86fa71bdd9.headline: Oil firm cuts P5 per liter on gasoline, diesel amid fuel price surge
n86fa71bdd9.summary: An oil company is cutting diesel and gasoline prices by P5 per liter at select branches nationwide. The move is intended to ease the burden of rising pump prices.
n86fa71bdd9.why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport and household costs, and pump price moves in the Philippines reflect global crude price swings.

n868df1c65c.headline: DGTR recommends anti-dumping duty on rayon yarn imports from China
n868df1c65c.summary: India's trade investigation body has recommended anti-dumping duties of $386 to $1,071 per metric ton on viscose rayon filament yarn imports from China.
n868df1c65c.why: Anti-dumping duties protect domestic producers from imports priced below fair value. Textile yarn costs affect Indian garment and fabric manufacturers.

n25a9087ec6.headline: India may impose anti dumping duty on Chinese LNG tank imports to protect domestic clean fuel ecosystem - BusinessToday
n25a9087ec6.summary: India may impose an anti-dumping duty on LNG tank imports from China to protect its domestic clean fuel ecosystem. If imposed, the duty could raise the cost of Chinese imports while helping local manufacturers.
n25a9087ec6.why: Anti-dumping duties are trade tariffs that governments use to offset imports priced below fair value. They shape costs for importers and competitiveness for domestic manufacturers.

n15599be424.headline: Singapore’s core inflation rises to 1.4% in February, highest since December 2024
n15599be424.summary: Singapore's core inflation rose to 1.4% in February, its highest since December 2024. Authorities said import cost pressures are likely to rise in the near term.
n15599be424.why: Core inflation strips out volatile items and guides monetary policy. Singapore manages its currency rather than interest rates, so inflation shapes the Singapore dollar outlook.

nb429239133.headline: HDFC Bank shares fall 4% to hit fresh 52 week low today; here's why - BusinessToday
nb429239133.summary: HDFC Bank shares fell 3.72% to a low of Rs 751.40, hitting a 52-week low. Trading volume in the first hour was well above the two-week average.
nb429239133.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, so its share price is a major factor in Indian banking indices.
nb429239133.why_moved: The input reports heavy selling in HDFC Bank shares, which pushed the stock to a 52-week low on the BSE.

n78cf731d3b.headline: Trump Delays Iran Ultimatum by Five Days After "Very Positive" Talks
n78cf731d3b.summary: US President Donald Trump announced a five-day postponement of a military ultimatum against Iran, following what he described as very positive talks.
n78cf731d3b.why: Military escalation involving Iran affects oil supply risk, and Brent crude is the global benchmark for crude pricing.
n78cf731d3b.why_moved: The postponement of the ultimatum, linked to described talks, reduces the near-term risk of military escalation affecting energy supply.

nb576d83111.headline: Marcos orders creation of crisis committee amid Middle East conflict
nb576d83111.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered the creation of a crisis committee to ensure stable oil supply and protect consumers amid the Middle East conflict.
nb576d83111.why: The Philippines imports most of its oil, so Middle East disruptions directly affect domestic fuel prices and inflation.

n3496536e5d.headline: Trump says the U.S. is in talks with Iran to end the war, which Iran denies
n3496536e5d.summary: Trump said the US will postpone strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure for five days and is in talks to end the war, which Iran denies, while Israel continued strikes on Tehran.
n3496536e5d.why: Strikes on energy infrastructure in the Gulf can disrupt oil supply, and Brent crude is the main global crude benchmark.
n3496536e5d.why_moved: Postponed strikes on Iranian energy assets ease near-term supply fears, while Iran's denial of talks and retaliation warnings keep uncertainty high.

n297d5eefa0.headline: Trump says he and 'the ayatollah' can share control of Strait of Hormuz
n297d5eefa0.summary: A US move to recognise Iran's sphere of influence over the strategic waterway would be a concession, the report said. Trump said he and the ayatollah could share control of the strait.
n297d5eefa0.why: Control over the Strait of Hormuz affects the shipping route for a large share of seaborne oil, so any change in its governance matters for energy markets.

nf2767454aa.headline: Oil prices ease and stocks jump after Trump says Iran is talking with the US, despite Iran’s denials
nf2767454aa.summary: Financial markets rallied on Monday after President Trump said the United States had talked with Iran, despite Iranian denials. Oil prices eased in the same session.
nf2767454aa.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies, and crude oil prices feed directly into energy costs, inflation expectations and corporate margins.
nf2767454aa.why_moved: Reports of US talks with Iran reduced fears of wider conflict in the Gulf, easing oil prices and lifting equities.

ncb5286059e.headline: Dollar scarcity in Venezuela forces small firms to raise prices, turn to crypto
ncb5286059e.summary: Small firms in central Venezuela face dollar shortages, forcing them to raise prices and increasingly use cryptocurrencies for transactions.
ncb5286059e.why: Dollar scarcity in Venezuela hampers imports and business operations, pushing companies to alternative payment methods like crypto, affecting local inflation and currency dynamics.

n4af0df8eae.headline: Which Cruise Giant Actually Delivers the Smarter Return for Investors?
n4af0df8eae.summary: Royal Caribbean delivered a 190.6% return over five years, outperforming Carnival and Norwegian Cruise Line, which posted negative returns over the same period.
n4af0df8eae.why: Cruise industry performance varies widely; Royal Caribbean's strong returns highlight its competitive positioning and recovery post-pandemic.
